notes.title: New Additions to Characters Update 👨 👩
notes.notes:
[h1]New Additions to Characters Update![/h1]

A big improvement for the customization and replay value side of Little Islanders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660416/a5296f742e719bce90baa9a32feea461e80f1be1.png[/img]

Just implemented more varieties of [b]clothing colours[/b], [b]skin colours[/b] and [b]accessory colours[/b]. The new 3D characters now show up and [b]work within the user interface[/b] as well. Yay!

[b]Upcoming / Features being worked on[/b]
[list]
[*] Character Blinking (For that little bit of extra detail)
[*] Improving the Building Ghost Effect
[*] Settler Sleeping animations
[*] Improving / Replacing certain stylized textures
[*] Implementing Water Features, Ponds and Rivers
[*] Waterfalls
[*] Big One; Introduction to the enemy faction.
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who has contributed feedback and helped share Little Islanders around, it’s very much appreciated and it’s a team effort!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42660416/3d43bebba23f03685ee79fd3f18a274a61665188.png[/img]
